examples.title: A failed call, docked
examples.description: Selecting a rail row docks its panel beside the conversation, about 340px wide, with an X to close it. The header reads "Send email" with "send-email" small and monospaced, then a red dot and "Failed 10.0s · call 28 of 30". The Input section lists its fields (To, Template, Order ID) and the Error section is a tinted danger block with the message first, then the code in monospace and Retryable Yes. Under it the panel says what retrying sends, then a full-width secondary "Ask the agent to retry" with a refresh icon and secondary "Copy input" and "Copy error" buttons. Approve elsewhere on the page stays the only primary action.

examples.title: The panel for each kind of call
examples.description: A done call shows its Input and its Result as fields with secondary "Copy input" and "Copy result". The waiting call carries a "Note (optional)" field with its description, a secondary Deny and the only primary, Approve. A running call shows its Input and a Result that reads "The result appears when the call finishes." The three panels are the same width.

examples.title: Below 1280px, an overlay
examples.description: Under 1280px the panel opens over the conversation on a dimming scrim, closed by its X or Esc, with the same Send email content as the docked panel. It docks only at 1280px and wider (190 sidebar + 250 list + about 480 conversation + 340 panel = 1,260 plus gutters), a threshold separate from the shared 1024px desktop breakpoint. This example forces the overlay so it shows at any width.
examples.code: (open = false)} />

examples.title: At 375px, a bottom sheet
examples.description: On a phone the panel is a full-height bottom sheet with a grabber and a Close button, like the shared sheets. The title is "Send email" with "send-email", a red "Failed · 10.0s · call 28 of 30", Input fields (To, Template), Error fields (Message, Retryable Yes) and a secondary full-width 44px "Ask the agent to retry" at the foot. It cross-fades under reduced motion.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { Button, ToolCallPanel } from '@lostgradient/cinder';

  let open = $state(false);
</script>

<Button variant="secondary" onclick={() => (open = true)}>Open the sheet</Button>
<ToolCallPanel
  bind:open
  placement="sheet"
  name="Send email"
  identifier="send-email"
  status="failed"
  duration="10.0s"
  position="call 28 of 30"
  input={{ to: 'maya@example.com', template: 'refund-notice' }}
  error={{ message: 'No reply from mail.example.com after 10s', retryable: true }}
  onRetry={() => (open = false)}
/>

examples.title: A phone sheet with JSON blocks
examples.description: The phone panel for Lookup order opens as a bottom sheet over the run page with a grabber, the title "Lookup order", Close, "Reads · ran in 0.4s", and Input and Output JSON blocks. The line under the title is the caller's own words, and Output is the Result heading renamed.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { Button, ToolCallPanel } from '@lostgradient/cinder';

  let open = $state(false);
</script>

<Button variant="secondary" onclick={() => (open = true)}>Open Lookup order</Button>
<ToolCallPanel
  bind:open
  placement="sheet"
  view="json"
  name="Lookup order"
  status="done"
  summary="Reads · ran in 0.4s"
  resultLabel="Output"
  input={'{ "orderId": "4471" }'}
  result={'{ "total": 42.00, "status": "paid" }'}
/>

examples.title: Beside the rail
examples.description: The rail and its panel together: the selected Send email row is tinted and its panel docks to the right. Esc or the X closes the panel and Close hands focus back to the row; choosing the row again closes it too.
